# Play Geometry Dash

> Play Geometry Dash Lite in a browser, with the game player kept separate from the site's guides and supporting information.

This site currently publishes reviewed English and Simplified Chinese versions of its home page, game page, and gameplay guide. The game itself is embedded from a separate Cloudflare R2-hosted player.

## Play

- [Play Geometry Dash Lite](https://play-geometry-dash.com/game/geometry-dash-lite): Open the browser game.
- [How to play Geometry Dash Lite](https://play-geometry-dash.com/how-to-play-geometry-dash-lite): Read controls and troubleshooting guidance.
- [Home](https://play-geometry-dash.com/): Explore the site and launch the game.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://play-geometry-dash.com/sitemap.xml)

This is an independent website and does not claim to be the official Geometry Dash or Geometry Dash Lite website. Game names and related rights belong to their respective owners.
